children: DePuy Synthes orthopedics unit in a deal that could value it at close ​to $20B, Bloomberg reported late Friday.
An agreement could be reached within several weeks, although the talks could still end without a deal, another bidder could emerge, or J&J
could decide to spin off the business as a publicly traded company, according to the report.
announced plans last October to separate its orthopedics business, which reportedly has attracted interest from several private equity firms.
DePuy Synthes, which makes devices used in hip and knee replacements, generated $9.3B in sales in 2025, and J&J
has said it would be the world's largest orthopedics company if it becomes a standalone entity.
